newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Euroyen unmoved by JGB gains, seen sideways.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Euroyen unmoved by JGB gains, seen sideways.

text.p: SIMEX Euroyen futures were stuck in tight, familiar ranges on Monday as Japanese government bond (JGB) futures continued to chart new highs.
Dealers said trade in the JGBs was largely technically driven due to a lack of fresh fundamental factors ahead of next week's industrial production data.

"A lot of technical buying came in. Sentiment is still bullish for the JGBs," said a trader with a Japanese futures house, adding that the June contract was likely to target 127.50 over the medium term.
June JGBs settled unchanged at 126.59 against their previous close after hitting a new high of 126.88.
December Euroyen ended at 99.19 against its IMM close at 99.20 on light volume of 5,765 lots.
Dealers said the Euroyen futures failed to make headway because the short end of the curve had already priced in steady interest rates through the summer.
"From this point on, it'll be quite difficult to move either way. Maybe we'll just see it at plus or minus five points from here," said the trader.
Another trader said December Euroyen faced strong selling interest at 99.23.
Eurodollar futures ended slightly firmer after the release of a much lower-than-expected U.S. February Producer Price Index last week calmed recent worries about an impending rate hike.
June Eurodollars ended at 94.165, unchanged from their IMM close, on volume of 5,650 lots. September was at 93.93 against 93.935.
